name: Generous body size and line height
definition: Is body text about 16-17px with generous line height (around 1.55-1.65)?

name: System font stack, no web fonts
definition: Does the page rely only on a system or system-ui font stack (Helvetica/Arial/system sans) with no custom web or icon fonts?

name: Uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow labels
definition: Are there small uppercase, letter-spaced labels (eyebrows, kickers, category or footer labels) above headings or titles?

name: Large bold headings with strong hierarchy
definition: Are headings (h1/h2) large and bold, creating a clear size hierarchy over body text?

name: Serif headings paired with sans body
definition: Are headings or display text set in a serif face while body and UI text use a sans-serif?

name: Card titles bold, not uppercase or link-styled
definition: Are card or article titles bold, left-aligned, in sentence/title case rather than uppercase, centered or default blue links?

name: All-caps headings
definition: Are headlines or section headings set in all uppercase?

name: Centered headings and intro text
definition: Are section headings or intro text centered?

name: Hero headline partly accent-colored
definition: Is part of the hero headline highlighted in an accent color or weight different from the rest?

name: Single sans family throughout
definition: Is one single sans-serif family used for all text including headings?

name: White hero headline on dark background
definition: Is the hero h1 large white text over a dark, image or gradient background?

name: Headings in title or sentence case
definition: Are the main headings in title or sentence case rather than all caps?

name: Link underline treatment
definition: Are links styled without underline or with underlines limited to inline text links?

name: Compact body line height, small h2
definition: Does the page use standard 16px body text with compact line height and small h2 sizes?

name: Copyright line small grey with hairline
definition: Is the copyright line small, sentence case, grey with a hairline rule above?

name: Excerpt and byline gray text under titles
definition: Do excerpts and bylines appear in gray sans text under article titles?

name: Hero h1 split into two sizes
definition: Is the hero h1 split into a large bold line and a smaller secondary line?

name: Light or regular weight headings
definition: Are section headings set at regular or light weight rather than bold?

name: Modest heading scale
definition: Are h2 headings small (about 22px) rather than large?

name: Navigation labels small title case near logo
definition: Are top navigation labels small, title case and grouped beside the logo?

name: News headlines medium-weight h4
definition: Are news headlines medium-weight sans-serif h4 headings?

name: Prices bold green with struck-through original
definition: Are prices bold and green with the original price struck through in grey?

name: Section titles with thick underline rule
definition: Do section titles have a thick rule beneath each?

name: Serif body with sans headings
definition: Is body text set in a serif while headings and UI use a sans-serif?

name: Alternating tinted section background bands
definition: Do full-width sections alternate between two or more background colors (e.g., white, cream, pale tint, dark) to separate content bands?

name: Blue-based palette with dark navy
definition: Is the palette built on navy and blue tones with light blue tints and accents?

name: Warm cream/off-white page background
definition: Is the page's main background a warm cream or off-white tone rather than pure white or black?

name: Single red accent color
definition: Is a single red, crimson or rust-red accent used for links, buttons and CTAs?

name: Dark theme page background
definition: Is the page background dark (near-black or dark navy) with light text?

name: Green-tinted dark body text
definition: Is body text a dark green-tinted color rather than neutral gray?

name: Navy-tinted dark body text
definition: Is body text a dark navy or blue-tinted slate rather than neutral gray or black?

name: Pink or magenta accent
definition: Is a hot pink, crimson-magenta or vivid magenta used as an accent?

name: Single orange accent color
definition: Is a single orange or burnt-orange accent used for buttons, links, labels and badges?

name: Dark brown or rust or purple-slate text
definition: Is body text a warm brown, rust or slate-purple tone?

name: Dark footer band
definition: Is the footer a very dark (charcoal or navy) band with light text?

name: Dark navy bands for secondary content
definition: Are dark navy bands used to anchor sections like hero, top bar or content blocks alongside light panels?

name: Earthy or warm multi-color palette
definition: Does the palette mix earthy or warm accent colors (teal, sage, tan, orange, peach) with warm off-white panels?

name: Near-black or charcoal body text
definition: Is body text a near-black or dark charcoal color rather than pure black?

name: Single cyan or teal accent color
definition: Is a single bright cyan, teal or mint accent used for buttons, links and highlights?

name: Two-tone text on dark (white headings, muted body)
definition: On a dark background, are headings white and supporting copy a muted grey or blue-grey tone?

name: Clean white header band
definition: Is the header band a clean white background?

name: Dark top announcement or utility bar
definition: Is there a dark top announcement or utility bar above the header?

name: Gradient hero background
definition: Is the hero background a gradient rather than a flat color?

name: Gray alert strip with white button
definition: Is there a solid mid-gray band with white text and a white button with colored text?

name: Green-based palette
definition: Is the palette built on green tones with mint or sage tints?

name: Light band interrupting dark page
definition: Does a light-colored band interrupt a dark page to hold content such as a logo strip?

name: Warm beige band separating sections
definition: Does a section use a warm off-white or beige background band to separate it from white areas?

name: Warm beige-gray neutral borders and fills
definition: Are borders and fills a muted warm beige-gray alongside white cards?

name: Uses CSS grid with flexbox
definition: Does the page layout rely on CSS grid and/or flexbox (rather than tables) for its structure?

name: Narrow centered content container
definition: Is the main content held in a centered, fixed or max-width container with generous side margins?

name: Dark multi-column footer
definition: Is the footer a dark band with multiple columns of links, headings and a bottom legal/copyright bar?

name: Two-column text/content sections
definition: Do intro, about or content sections use a two-column layout (heading/text beside text/photo/lists)?

name: Compact header with logo and inline nav
definition: Is the header a compact single row with a small logo and navigation beside it?

name: Multi-column card grids
definition: Are list or feature items shown as multi-column grids of uniform cards or tiles?

name: Single column of stacked full-width sections
definition: Is the page a single column of stacked full-width bands with no sidebar?

name: Two-column split hero
definition: Is the hero split into two columns with text on one side and an image or form on the other?

name: Short compact page
definition: Is the page short and compact with few sections and tight spacing?

name: Alternating zig-zag image/text rows
definition: Do feature or split sections alternate image and text sides in a zig-zag?

name: Hero text directly on image
definition: Is the hero a left-aligned headline over a full-bleed photo or static background with no backing panel or carousel?

name: Centered intro text in narrow measure
definition: Are section headings and intro paragraphs centered in a narrow text column?

name: Compact footer
definition: Is the footer compact, with inline links and a small logo above the copyright?

name: Full-width brand band
definition: Is there a dedicated full-width dark band with large heading for a brand statement?

name: Hero slides in fixed frame
definition: Are hero images scaled and slides stacked in one centered fixed-width frame?

name: Long full-width paragraph lines
definition: Do paragraphs span the full card width with long line lengths?

name: Multi-tier header
definition: Does the header have several tiers such as announcement bar, utility bar and main nav?

name: Quick links horizontal row
definition: Are quick links presented as a single horizontal row with a small label?

name: Sidebar magazine layout
definition: Does the page use a main column with a right sidebar?

name: Tall airy page with generous spacing
definition: Is the page tall with generous whitespace between sections?

name: Text separate from images, no overlap
definition: Are text and images in separate regions with no overlays, truncation or overlap?

name: Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with
definition: Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with left-aligned lines.

name: Uneven card heights and orphans
definition: Do card grids show uneven heights or orphaned cells?

name: Fully rounded pill primary buttons
definition: Are the primary calls to action fully rounded pill-shaped buttons?

name: Equal bordered card grids
definition: Are items shown as equal-sized bordered cards in a grid or row?

name: Arrow-suffixed text links
definition: Do links or tiles end with an arrow glyph or arrow accent?

name: Compact header with logo and text links
definition: Is the header a compact single-row bar with small logo and plain text links?

name: Minimal newsletter signup form
definition: Is the newsletter signup a minimal single-email-input form with one button?

name: Rectangular or modest-radius buttons
definition: Are the buttons rectangular or only modestly rounded (about 4-8px) rather than pills?

name: Widespread rounded corners on cards
definition: Are rounded corners (8px or more) used widely across cards, tiles and inputs?

name: Cards with accent left border
definition: Do cards or notices have a colored left border accent?

name: Full-width announcement strip
definition: Is there a thin full-width colored announcement or promo strip?

name: Hairline dividers between list items
definition: Are list rows separated by thin rules or dividers?

name: Hero or promo in solid color panel
definition: Is the hero or promo a solid or gradient colored panel with large white heading?

name: Payment method badges
definition: Does the page show a row of payment-method logos or badges (or explicitly omit them)?

name: Search or select bar near hero
definition: Is there a dedicated search or select bar in or beneath the hero?

name: Translucent blurred header
definition: Is the header translucent with backdrop blur?

name: Dark footer with logo
definition: Is the footer a dark band repeating the white logo?

name: Outlined pill chips as links
definition: Are category or suggestion links styled as small pill chips?

name: Simple contact or form controls
definition: Does the page use simple forms with few native controls and clear labels?

name: Small pill badges and labels
definition: Are badges or labels small accent-colored pills?

name: Social icons in circles or outlined pills
definition: Are social links shown as outlined circular badges or outlined button tiles?

name: Solid accent color info block
definition: Is key info or quick links placed in a solid accent-colored block or band?

name: Carousel and pagination indicators
definition: Are carousel or pagination controls shown as styled dots or circles with active state?

name: Dark utility bar above nav
definition: Is there a compact utility bar with text links above the main navigation?

name: Filled primary paired with outlined secondary
definition: Does the page pair a filled primary button with an outlined secondary button?

name: Minimal footer
definition: Is the footer slim and minimal with little content?

name: Navigation without dropdown carets
definition: Are navigation labels plain without dropdown carets or chevrons?

name: Social links as plain text
definition: Are social links plain text labels or a single link without icon graphics?

name: Statistics as separate cards
definition: Are statistics shown as separate cards or columns with large numerals?

name: Underlined centered secondary link
definition: Is a secondary link underlined and centered under the main button?

name: Few icon glyphs
definition: Does the interface avoid icon glyphs and rely on text labels?

name: Logos on light rounded plates
definition: Are partner, sponsor or certification logos set on light rounded tiles?

name: Text wordmark logo
definition: Is the site name a text wordmark rather than an image logo?

name: Text-only cards without images
definition: Are content cards text-only with no images?

name: Back-to-top control
definition: Is there a pill-styled back-to-top control?

name: Calendar and footer link cards
definition: Does the page use rounded card calendars or footer link groups in bordered cards?

name: Circular initials avatars
definition: Are avatars circular initials rather than photos?

name: Compact promo banners
definition: Are secondary promos compact horizontal banners with thumbnails?

name: Event dates on news items
definition: Does every news item show a date?

name: Hero translucent value cards
definition: Does the hero show a row of translucent value-proposition cards with check icons?

name: Image gradient overlay cards
definition: Do cards have text over a darkening gradient overlay?

name: Italic serif item strip
definition: Are item titles shown in an italic serif strip with bullets?

name: Nav links light over hero photo
definition: Are nav links light-weight white text over the hero photo with no active state?

name: Plain text featured tag
definition: Is the featured tag a plain colored text label rather than a filled badge?

name: RSS link with icon and label
definition: Is the RSS link a small icon with an explicit text label?

name: Section heading decoration
definition: Do section headings carry accent underlines, rules or a view-all link?

name: Social login sign-up panel
definition: Is there a dedicated sign-up panel with social login buttons?

name: Rounded corners on cards and containers
definition: Do cards, images and containers use moderately to generously rounded corners (roughly 6–16px radii) rather than square corners?

name: Flat design without shadows or gradients
definition: Is the styling flat, with no box shadows, gradients, or animations?

name: Gradient hero background
definition: Does the hero have a gradient or glow background?

name: Shadow only on hero image
definition: Is a soft shadow applied sparingly, limited to the hero image or card and a few key images?

name: Alternating background bands between sections
definition: Are sections separated by alternating solid or tinted background color bands?

name: Text glyph icons without SVG or icon fonts
definition: Are icons absent or text-based, with no SVG or icon fonts?

name: Dark overlay on photo backgrounds
definition: Is a dimmed or tinted overlay placed over a photo background with white text on top?

name: Soft shadowed white cards
definition: Are cards white or cream, rounded, with soft diffuse shadows and generous padding?

name: Square corners everywhere
definition: Are all elements square-cornered with no rounded corners, pills or circles?

name: Thin borders and hairline separators
definition: Are content and sections separated by thin borders, rules or hairlines rather than hr dividers?

name: Accent bar or rule on headings and quotes
definition: Are there short accent-colored underline bars or left rules on headings or pull quotes?

name: Decorative background graphic in hero
definition: Does the hero include a faded decorative graphic such as stripes behind the headline?

name: More shadows and transforms for depth
definition: Do surfaces use many box shadows and transforms to create depth?

name: Descriptive image alt text
definition: Do images carry descriptive, human-readable alt text naming their content or item?

name: Rounded or circular image crops
definition: Are images cropped into circles or rounded-corner tiles or cards?

name: Darkened or color-overlaid photo backgrounds
definition: Do hero or feature sections use full-bleed photos or artwork with a dark or colored overlay behind text?

name: Empty alt on decorative images
definition: Is alt text empty for decorative images or thumbnails while hero or people images have descriptive alt?

name: Text glyph icons
definition: Are icons rendered as text glyphs or emoji rather than image, sprite, or icon-font icons?

name: Color blocks replace images
definition: Are images replaced by flat or gradient color blocks or neutral gray placeholders instead of photos?

name: Logo sizing and repetition
definition: Are logos large or repeated, or low-visibility (light logos on white tiles falling back to text)?

name: Repeated placeholder or reused images
definition: Is the same image or placeholder reused repeatedly in multiple tiles or places?

name: Uniform square-cropped images
definition: Are images or thumbnails cropped to uniform sizes or aspect ratios (square, tall) across cards?

name: CSS background images for photos
definition: Are photos shown as CSS background images rather than img elements?

name: Distorted or oversized images
definition: Are images stretched, distorted, or oversized so they break an otherwise uniform layout?

name: No photographic imagery
definition: Does the page lack photographs or illustrative images, using only dark gradient backgrounds, text cards, logos and badges?

name: Photos on collection cards
definition: Are photographs used as card imagery with product or item lists beneath them?

name: Uniform icon sizing in cards
definition: Are icons sized uniformly (about 60px) and styled consistently within cards?

name: Brand plus tagline title
definition: Does the document title combine the brand name with a descriptive tagline or phrase separated by a pipe, dash or similar?

name: Arrow glyphs on links and labels
definition: Do links, card titles or buttons end with a text arrow glyph such as →?

name: Subtitle microcopy beneath headings or banners
definition: Does a heading, hero or banner have a short descriptive subtitle or tagline line beneath it?

name: Persuasive marketing microcopy
definition: Does the copy use marketing-style taglines, badges, friendly CTAs and promotional phrasing?

name: Short brand-only page title
definition: Is the document title just a short brand or organization name, with no tagline, keywords or subtitle?

name: Short concise title, not keyword-stuffed
definition: Is the document title short and concise rather than a long keyword-stuffed or descriptive string (including brand–descriptor forms)?

name: Typographic curly quotes and dashes
definition: Does the copy use typographic punctuation such as curly apostrophes, curly quotes, en dashes or em dashes?

name: Calm tone, few exclamation marks
definition: Is the tone calm with no or few exclamation marks?

name: Contact details as short link text
definition: Are contact details shown as short link text or plain text rather than raw addresses or forms?

name: Sentence or title case labels
definition: Do labels and microcopy use sentence or title case rather than all lowercase or uppercase?

name: Title repeats hero headline
definition: Does the document title incorporate or repeat the hero headline text?

name: Title with byline or product brand list
definition: Does the document title list product brands or an author byline instead of a keyword phrase?

name: Casual lowercase friendly copy
definition: Is secondary copy short, casual and lowercase with a personal tone?

name: Condensed low word-count copy
definition: Is the page copy condensed, with fewer words and dropped lists or teasers?

name: Descriptive category hero headline
definition: Is the hero headline a short descriptive category phrase rather than an artwork title?

name: Full untruncated news headlines
definition: Are news headlines shown in full without truncation?

name: Prices bold with 'from $' prefix
definition: Are prices shown in bold accent color with a 'from $' prefix for variable pricing?

name: Short uppercase section headings
definition: Are sections introduced with short uppercase headings or eyebrow labels?

name: Title uses pipe and curly apostrophes
definition: Does the document title use a pipe separator together with typographic curly apostrophes?

name: Semantic landmark elements used
definition: Does the page structure content with HTML5 semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, section, article, aside, footer) rather than generic divs?

name: Lean minimal markup
definition: Is the markup lean, with few scripts, classes, inline styles and no external stylesheets?

name: Clean sequential heading hierarchy
definition: Does the page have a clean, properly nested heading outline (h1 then h2 sections then h3 items, without skipped levels)?

name: Descriptive image alt text
definition: Do images carry meaningful descriptive alt text (with none missing)?

name: Single h1 hero headline
definition: Does the page have exactly one h1 holding the main headline?

name: Blockquote/cite quote markup
definition: Are quotes marked up with semantic elements such as blockquote, cite, figure/figcaption or q?

name: Minimal head meta tags
definition: Does the head include only standard meta tags such as charset, viewport and description?

name: Main landmark present
definition: Is the page content wrapped in a main element?

name: ARIA attributes present
definition: Does the page include ARIA attributes for accessibility?

name: Descriptive page title
definition: Does the page title use a full organization name or brand plus tagline rather than a generic label?

name: List markup for link groups
definition: Are navigation menus and link groups built as ul/li lists?

name: Missing h1 in heading outline
definition: Is the page lacking an h1, with the top-level heading being an h2 or lower?

name: Real button and label elements
definition: Does the page use native button elements (and labels) for actions and form inputs?

name: Spans for small labels
definition: Are spans or small/strong/b inline tags used for small labels and secondary text?

name: Address element for contact
definition: Are contact details wrapped in an address element?

name: Images mostly have empty alt
definition: Do content images mostly have empty alt attributes?

name: Lang attribute without region
definition: Does the html lang attribute name only a language without a region?

name: Live text headings not images
definition: Are headings live styled text rather than images of lettering?

name: Native dialog login
definition: Is the login a single native dialog element containing a form?

name: Struck-through original prices use semantic s elements.
definition: Struck-through original prices use semantic s elements.

name: Self-contained page without external assets
definition: Does the page ship with no external scripts or stylesheets, using a single inline style block?

name: Lean lightweight markup
definition: Is the page markup lean, with few scripts, few classes, few divs and minimal inline styles and metadata?

name: Awkward mid-word wrapping in narrow cards
definition: Do long words in narrow cards wrap or break mid-word, creating awkward line breaks?

name: Hover transitions on interactive elements
definition: Does the page define CSS transitions for interactive hover states?

name: Minimal CSS transitions
definition: Does the page define few or no CSS transitions, so interaction animation is minimal?

name: Mismatched or reused icons in chips
definition: Are icons in social or link chips mismatched with their labels or reused across different chips?
